observations: Photo 0 shows two transmission units/assemblies on the ground: one larger bellhousing/gearbox assembly and another smaller unit; both appear used and dusty, with visible wiring/hoses and mounting points.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the underside/side of a transmission with exposed wiring connectors and metal housings; no clear label/part number is readable.
Photo 2 shows a wider top/side view of a transmission assembly with many hoses/wires and mounting brackets; no clear brand/model plate is readable.

claims.claim: automatic gearbox and manual gearbox for toyota corolla, carry, hillux
claims.evidence: Photos show transmission assemblies but no readable identification plate, VIN/part number, or clear Toyota model/gearbox type markings.
No shipping documents, labels, or Belgium markings are visible in the photos.
No test video, scan tool report, or proof of operation is shown; photos only show the units.
No audio/video of running or inspection report is provided.
No odometer/ECU mileage reading or gearbox internal mileage indicator is visible.
Photos do not show tamper-proof seals, torque marks, or clear evidence of whether the unit has been opened.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox type/model fit (automatic vs manual, and wrong Toyota variant) because no readable identification is shown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number + transmission code) and/or the sticker with Toyota application, plus a photo showing the exact connector/gearbox type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case: unknown fit/unknown type, treated as not guaranteed for the buyer’s exact Toyota.

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (could have internal faults not visible in photos).
risks.proof: Short video of the gearbox being run/tested (engaged through gears) or a mechanic test sheet with results.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Possible damage/leaks or missing components (hoses/wiring look present but completeness is unclear).
risks.proof: Photos of all ports/connectors from multiple angles, including the fluid fill/drain areas and any sensors/solenoids; confirm no missing brackets/solenoids.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty (dust/handling marks; could be from a failed unit).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing for cracks, dents, and oil seepage; include a wipe-clean area to show fresh condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown condition.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (transmission code + part number) for the exact unit being sold.
Video proof of testing/operation (engage gears and show it runs without abnormal noise).
Photos of all connectors/ports and confirmation of included sensors/solenoids/hoses (everything needed to install).
Any document/label supporting “direct from Belgium” and “low mileage” (if available).
response.reason: The photos show transmission assemblies but do not provide readable identification (model/part number) or proof of testing/working. Without that, even a worst-case price would be unreliable for the exact item and fit.
